text:
ISTATS::get
Description
Reads in the value associated with the given
iStats
key
Syntax
ISTATS
::
get
<
key
>
ISTATS::get
Always reads aggregate (not tmm-local) value
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
if
{
[
string
tolower
[
HTTP
::
uri
]]
equals
"/12345"
}
{
ISTATS
::
incr
"uri /12345 r Requests"
1
HTTP
::
uri
"/"
HTTP
::
redirect
"http://www.mysite.com"
}
elseif
{
[
string
tolower
[
HTTP
::
uri
]]
equals
"/stats"
}
{
HTTP
::
respond
200
content
"<html><body>Requests for /12345: [ISTATS::get "uri /12345 r Requests"]</body></html>"
}
}
